description: Ministry of Education - Degree Awarding Institute Order Bachelor of Business Management - Business Management School (Private) Limited
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the Minister of Education exercising powers under the Universities Act to amend degree programs at a private institution. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - specifically the amendment of regulations governing degree programs and institutional recognition under existing legislation.
